description.value:
You conjure a wall of Force-wreathed fire anchored to a solid surface within range — straight, up to 60 feet long, 20 feet high, and 1 foot thick, or ringed, up to 20 feet across, 20 feet high, and 1 foot thick. The wall is opaque and persists for the duration.

When it appears, each creature in its area must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take 5d8 energy damage, half as much on a success. You designate one face of the wall when you cast it; that face deals 5d8 energy damage to any creature that ends its turn within 10 feet of it or inside the wall, and the same damage to a creature that enters the wall for the first time on a turn or ends its turn there. The other face is harmless.

Cast with a 5th-level slot or higher, the damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 4th.
